scope: Latest recovered runs of the three original experiments. Additional faults and combinations remain in experiment history.

insights.title: Evaluate automated restart policy
insights.hypothesis: If a liveness probe is configured, then the orchestrator should automatically restart the ledgerwriter process upon exit.
insights.verification: Simulate a process exit and verify if the orchestrator triggers an automatic restart.

insights.title: Evaluate automated process health monitoring
insights.hypothesis: If automated monitoring detects paused processes, then the system can trigger alerts or auto-unpause to reduce MTTR.
insights.verification: Verify that alerts trigger when a container enters a paused state.

insights.title: Evaluate circuit breaker configuration for ledgerwriter dependencies
insights.hypothesis: If circuit breakers are implemented on ledgerwriter's calls to ledger-db, then cascading latency impact on the frontend can be mitigated during future network impairments.
insights.verification: Simulate network latency on ledger-db and observe if ledgerwriter trips the circuit breaker to protect the frontend.

insights.title: Evaluate shutdown signal handling
insights.hypothesis: Whether the service is receiving unexpected SIGTERM signals causing premature graceful shutdowns.
insights.verification: Review infrastructure logs for unexpected termination signals sent to the ledgerwriter container.
